# Declared Unicode coverage of the baked font subsets in libs/ra8_fonts/.
#
# This file is the record of which characters the reader can draw with no SD
# card present, and scripts/checks/check_font_coverage.py holds it against the
# committed .ttf bytes in both directions: every declared codepoint must be in
# the font's cmap, and every codepoint in that cmap must be declared here. So
# widening or narrowing the baked coverage is an edit to this file plus a new
# subset, reviewable as a diff, rather than a replaced 37 KB blob.
#
# Before this declaration existed, the only record of the set was the
# pyftsubset recipe in the docstring of scripts/gen/font_to_c.py, and it did
# not match the file: the recipe asks for 0020-00FF, while the committed
# subset carries 0020-007E and 00A0-00FF, i.e. not the 33 unencoded C1
# codepoints 007F-009F. `check_font_coverage.py --recipe` now prints the
# arguments that actually reproduce each committed subset.
#
# Format, one block per baked font:
#   font <subset path> source <face it was cut from, or - for a whole face>
#   range <HEX> | <HEX>-<HEX>     inclusive, ascending, one row per gap
# Rows are ordered and may not touch: two adjacent ranges are one range.
# The #! directives restate the row counts and are re-derived by the checker.
#
# Scope note: this declares the BAKED subsets only. A font provisioned on the
# microSD card (FONT.OTF, read by ra8_sdfont_load) carries whatever coverage
# the card's owner put on it and cannot be gated from the tree.
#
#! fonts: 1
#! ranges: 6
#! codepoints: 198

# The reading-body face: Literata Regular (SIL OFL 1.1), subset for targets
# that cannot spend flash on all 1163 codepoints of the committed face.
font libs/ra8_fonts/literata_latin1.ttf source libs/ra8_fonts/Literata-Regular.ttf
range 0020-007E  Basic Latin, printable ASCII from space to tilde
range 00A0-00FF  Latin-1 Supplement from no-break space; the C1 block is unencoded
range 2013-2014  en dash, em dash
range 2018-2019  single quotation marks, left and right
range 201C-201D  double quotation marks, left and right
range 2026       horizontal ellipsis
